title: EP-Governance Transfer Package
description: Schema for a transfer package used to export and import lattice state between EP-Governance instances.

schema_version.description: Version of the transfer package schema.

package_version.description: Version of this transfer package instance.

source_lattice_id.description: XID of the source lattice this package was exported from.

source_project_id.description: XID of the source project this package was exported from.

snapshot_sequence.description: Sequence number of this snapshot within the source lattice.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this transfer package was created.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the package content, prefixed with 'sha256:'.

signature.description: Signature over the package content by the signer.

signer_id.description: XID of the principal that signed this transfer package.

trust_status.description: Trust status of this transfer package.

nodes.description: Array of node objects in the lattice.

edges.description: Array of edge objects in the lattice.

policies.description: Array of policy objects in the lattice.

branch_heads.description: Object mapping branch XIDs to their current head node XIDs.
